rubric_items.reason: CO-1 to CO-5 are built as designed, CO-6 is confirmed as a pass-through, and the literal tests are now added (prior F-1 is fixed). Small gap: of the EP-4 to EP-7 regression checks the design asks for, only cancel (EP-4) is tested.

API fields are snake_case per A-06. SQL stays in the repository and rules in the service. The id is still a bound parameter. Tests sit in the existing api/test and web __tests__ folders. No convention breaks found.

Seven files: the five source files the design names plus two test files. Some noise remains: the status columns go into the shared SUMMARY_SELECT, so the dashboard, doctor and patient summary queries fetch columns they never use.
location.state is type-checked and cut to 300 characters. Any status other than ACTIVE blocks the button. With no state the reason starts empty. Server-side Active and length checks stay in place.
The summary matches the diff for each component and test file. It now names every SUMMARY_SELECT reader (dashboard, doctor and patient repositories), so prior F-2 is fixed.

findings.text: The design asks for a regression check on EP-5 to EP-7 (reschedule, complete, no-show) too, 'same as EP-4'. The new tests cover only the cancel action. Low risk, because all four routes return this.get(id).

cites.quote: EP-5 POST /api/appointments/:id/reschedule — existing: same as EP-4.
HMS-14 REQ-17 (A-05): the cancel action returns the same detail shape with both statuses

findings.suggested_fix: Add one assertion for reschedule, complete or no-show returning doctor_status and patient_status. Or state in Known that only cancel is pinned because all four routes share this.get.

findings.text: The API tests depend on run order and shared state: the cancel test uses appointment 1, which the first test booked, and the INACTIVE tests rely on earlier PATCHes whose response status is never checked.
findings.suggested_fix: Book the appointment in beforeAll or inside each test, and assert that the PATCH returns 204 before reading the detail.

findings.text: The Summary now names all SUMMARY_SELECT readers, which fixes prior F-2. But resolves lists only F-1, so the F-2 fix is not traced.

cites.quote: The other readers of the shared select are the list reads, the dashboard service, the doctor repository and the patient repository (C14, C15, C16).
Regression tests now pin the ACTIVE and INACTIVE status literals on the detail GET and the cancel action, and unit-test bookAgainBlockers.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an F-2 entry to resolves that names the dashboard, doctor and patient readers.
